content.text: Building a Second Brain: A Proven Method to Organize Your Digital Life and Unlock Your Creative Potential — Tiago Forte describes the CODE method (Capture, Organise, Distil, Express) and the PARA system (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) as the backbone of a personal knowledge management system. The book argues that externalising knowledge into a trusted system frees mental RAM for creative thinking.
